## Pending approvals to Slack
Every hour this workflow lists the approvals that are still pending in PostSider and posts one Slack message for each.

1. Select your PostSider credential in the PostSider node and your Slack credential in the Slack node.
2. In the Slack node, choose the channel that should get the messages.
3. Activate the workflow.

The workflow only reads and notifies. It does not approve or reject anything. A pending approval is announced again at every run until someone decides it in PostSider, so shorten the schedule or add a filter if that is too noisy.

The PostSider API key needs the scope `approvals:read`. Approval operations need PostSider server 2026-11 or newer.
